Control Title: Enforce a fail-closed container workload admission baseline
Control Summary: Bind an exact OCI image and authenticated provenance to a non-root isolated resource-bounded Kubernetes workload before admission.

Threat Actor or Source: forged release producer compromised build path or deployer attaching valid but unrelated provenance
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: admission trusts a user-supplied pass flag or provenance whose subject is not the exact manifest digest about to run
Why This Check Is Required: immutable image identity does not establish origin so consumer-side authenticity and subject verification must be rerun at the use boundary
Required State: PSB-REL-001 successfully verifies signature builder source and exact OCI manifest subject
Verification Method: compose and execute the PSB-REL-001 verifier before returning allow
Expected Result: invalid signature wrong subject substituted manifest and unavailable verifier deny or error
Required Evidence: PSB-REL-001 verifier output; provenance expectation policy
Framework Mappings: nist-sp-800-190 SP 800-190 (September 2017) / 4.1.5 / supports / high; nist-sp-800-190 SP 800-190 (September 2017) / 4.4.5 / mitigates / high; slsa 1.2 / build-l2#consumer-validates-authenticity / verifies / high; slsa 1.2 / build-provenance / verifies / high
Limitations: Repository fixtures do not prove that a live Kubernetes API server admission controller CNI or runtime enforces the recorded settings.; The first slice accepts exactly one unique image identity per workload evidence bundle; production adapters must provide separate provenance evidence for every distinct init application and ephemeral image.; The default-deny NetworkPolicy fixture does not validate the narrower allow policies required for real application traffic.; Resource quantity parsing intentionally supports ordinary CPU values and Ki Mi Gi memory units only and is not a complete Kubernetes quantity parser.; Runtime PID enforcement is platform-owned evidence because standard workload resource fields do not provide a portable per-container PID limit.; Service account RBAC projected token audience secret delivery and namespace policy require separate controls or later adapters.; Image vulnerability and secret scanning remain PSB-DETECT-001 and PSB-CODE-001 responsibilities.; Registry lifecycle host or daemon hardening and runtime behavioral monitoring remain PSB-CONTAINER-002 through PSB-CONTAINER-004.; SLSA mappings apply only to CNT-002 actual PSB-REL-001 composition and do not establish a SLSA Build level.; No CIS Docker Benchmark mapping is claimed because the authorized versioned benchmark source remains input-required.
